::: {.callout-warning}
## The current schedule has not been announced

The table below summarizes the shape of the November 22, 2025 meeting. It is
provided as a reference, not as the schedule for the next SoCal BOOM.
:::

## 2025 at a glance

| Time | Activity |
|---|---|
| 9:00 AM | Registration and refreshments |
| 9:25 AM | Welcoming remarks |
| 9:30 AM | Oral Session 1: laboratory-based research |
| 10:30 AM | Coffee and snack break |
| 10:45 AM | Keynote presentation |
| 11:30 AM | Poster Session 1 |
| 12:30 PM | Lunch and breakout session |
| 1:30 PM | Poster Session 2 |
| 2:30 PM | Oral Session 2: field-based research |
| 3:30 PM | Coffee and snack break |
| 3:50 PM | Oral Session 3: modeling, followed by lightning talks |
| 4:50 PM | Closing remarks |
| 5:30 PM | Informal dinner |

The 2025 program combined laboratory, field, observational, and modeling
research with two poster sessions and an invited keynote. The keynote speaker
was Noelle Held, presenting on nutrient limitation at the San Pedro Ocean
Time-series.

Current speaker assignments, poster sessions, and social-event details will be
added when the new program is finalized.

*[Source: archived 2025 oral schedule](https://socalboom.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/oralscheduleflyer-1.pdf).*
